children: LOS ANGELES, Nov. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Global law firm

represented TNL Mediagene (Nasdaq: TNMG) and the special committee of its board of directors in two related transactions. TNL Mediagene is a Taipei-headquartered technology company that provides artificial-intelligence-powered advertising, marketing technology, content commerce, and data analytics solutions to brands and agencies across Asia.

The first transaction was the sale of its Japanese business through a management buyout. The second was a strategic equity investment by Vector Advisory Partners LLC (Vector). Both transactions closed Oct. 30, according to the company's press releases announcing the

In the management buyout, TNL Mediagene sold TNL Mediagene Inc., its Japanese holding company for Mediagene Inc. and Infobahn Inc. The buyer was MI Company Inc., an acquisition vehicle for an investor group led by the company's former Chief Executive Officer Motoko Imada. A special committee of disinterested and independent directors reviewed, evaluated, and negotiated the transaction. The board approved it following the committee's unanimous recommendation.

In the Vector transaction, TNL Mediagene issued newly authorized convertible preferred shares to Vector's designees. The investment is expected to result in a change of control of the company once the required shareholder, Nasdaq, Cayman Islands, and other approvals are received. TNL Mediagene continues to own and operate its business in Taiwan. TNL Mediagene also announced it has regained compliance with Nasdaq's stockholders' equity requirement.

Greenberg Traurig's multioffice Corporate team advising TNL Mediagene included Shareholders Homin Lee, Frank M. Placenti, Bradley J. Wyatt, Yejee Marilyn Kim, Mori Inada, Makoto Koinuma, and Chris (Sang Min) Shim; Of Counsels Satoshi Kubota, Motohiro Matsumura, and Kristy "Kitt" Ritter; and Associates Jiwon (Jessica) Lee and Andrew Ford.

Lawyers in the firm's Corporate Practice advise public and private companies, boards and special committees, investors, and financial institutions on a broad range of transactional and governance matters. Their work includes mergers and acquisitions, management buyouts, private placements and other capital markets transactions, and securities regulatory compliance. Drawing on a global platform, the team helps clients carry out complex cross-border transactions across the Americas, Europe, and Asia.

Greenberg Traurig, LLP has approximately 3,200 lawyers across 51 locations in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Latin America, and Asia. The firm's broad geographic and practice range enables the delivery of innovative and strategic legal services across borders and industries. 400. Greenberg Traurig is also known for its philanthropic giving, culture, innovation, and pro bono work. Web: www.gtlaw.com.
